posts.zh:
dsh-opencodego-usage 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e5e7678e0a5a68151bc.html
posts.en:
dsh-opencodego-usage is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6e5e7678e0a5a68151bc.html
